subIssueCommand: gh pmu sub create --parent $ISSUE --title "QA: [AC description]" --label qa-required -F .tmp-qa-body.md
closurePath: Option A (config wins, #2472): the '- [ ]' box is an open QA gate. The parent moves to in_review via the Step 4b QA force-exception and stays there until all QA sub-issues are closed and their AC boxes are checked; only then can the parent reach done.
